litigation.note: The Company is part of the IL&FS group and its resolution process, initiated by the reconstituted IL&FS Board under orders of the Hon'ble NCLAT, is still underway. A binding bid received from an overseas Fund for the promoters' equity stake has been approved by the secured lenders with an overwhelming majority; the bid-cum-resolution plan is under consideration by Hon'ble Justice D K Jain (Retd.) and would be followed by sanction of the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai. Under the plan, unsecured dues of operational creditors as on the 15 October 2018 cut-off date, as admitted by the Claim Advisor, would be settled, and legal cases filed against the Company pertaining to pre-October 2018 claims are stated to stand infructuous. The Directors' Report records that no new significant or material orders have been passed by regulators, courts or tribunals impacting the going concern status.

risks.note: Under the IL&FS resolution framework the Company is classified as a 'Red Entity', indicating its current inability to service debt and operational liabilities. The NCLAT moratorium covers all liabilities existing as on the 15 October 2018 cut-off date, so the Company is not servicing pre-cut-off dues to lenders and operational creditors. The resolution process is still underway, has a significant impact on business plans, and business realignment and financial restructuring are expected to continue over the next several months with significant uncertainties.
risks.risk: Unresolved IL&FS resolution process and 'Red Entity' classification

risks.note: The Company's net worth is fully eroded and prevailing financial constraints, particularly on bank guarantee requirements, have currently limited its ability to participate in new project bidding despite substantial prospects across Power, Oil & Gas, Railways & Metros, Roads and Buildings & Structures. The Company also continues to default on loans to lenders including borrowings from promoter group entities.
risks.risk: Fully eroded net worth constraining bank guarantees and new bidding

risks.note: The Company has experienced a prolonged period of limited order inflows over the past six years, except for two subcontracting assignments (Surat Metro Rail Works for Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation and Bhubaneswar Metro Rail Works for Delhi Metro Rail Corporation, the latter shelved by the Govt. of Odisha). Existing projects are nearing completion or approaching end of term, which has already caused a significant reduction in operations over the past three years.
risks.risk: Order book risk - prolonged absence of new order inflows

risks.note: The IL&FS Group debt crisis and related corporate governance concerns have adversely impacted the reputation of associated entities including the Company, creating challenges in securing new EPC contracts, obtaining favourable financing and availing credit support from vendors and suppliers.
risks.risk: Reputation and brand risk from the IL&FS group debt crisis

risks.note: Operational challenges in project execution may result in cost escalations and schedule overruns; mitigation rests on detailed planning and control over project design, subcontractor selection, supplier management, recruitment, resource deployment and insurance, supported by documented SOPs and project monitoring systems.

Dependence on subcontractors and joint venture partners for project execution exposes the Company to non-performance risk that may adversely impact revenue and profitability; mitigated through stringent evaluation and selection and continuous performance monitoring.

The Company is exposed to contractual risk in dealings with clients, subcontractors, suppliers and lenders in the ordinary course of business; a dedicated Contracts Department handles contract administration, management of significant claims and coordination of arbitration proceedings with the Legal team.

Materials lying at completed, foreclosed or terminated project sites cannot be redeployed given the inability to secure new projects; the Company is undertaking disposal of surplus materials, subject to necessary approvals, to minimise losses from deterioration, obsolescence or theft.
risks.risk: Material risk - surplus stock at completed, foreclosed or terminated sites
